run_pipeline_wan_text_to_video: run the WanPipeline to generate a video from a text prompt with specified dimensions and frames
encode_prompt_wan: encode a text prompt into T5 hidden state embeddings using the WanPipeline text encoder
prepare_latents_wan: prepare random latent tensors with correct temporal and spatial dimensions for Wan video generation
check_inputs_wan: validate pipeline inputs including prompt format, dimensions divisibility, and guidance scale consistency
use_two_stage_denoising_wan: configure WanPipeline with transformer_2 and boundary_ratio for two-stage high-noise and low-noise denoising
